{{Quote|Take 'em out!|The Klatooinian fires at Sergeant Remy|<ref name="TOO" />}}
A '''Klatooinian''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a member of a band of pariahs who lived in a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|settlement]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] during the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] worked closely with the settlement's leader, [[Gaan]], and held some leadership roles. When a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] arrived on Ragmar V in order to establish a Republic outpost, the Klatooinian fired a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] at the gunship, destroying it. However, the occupants, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Joc Sah]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachment, survived and began to make their way to the [[City/Legends|settlement]].

The pariahs gathered to make a stand against the Republic for their own reasons, but when Sah and his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] arrived, the clones received the command to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] that labeled all Jedi as traitors to the Republic. In order to avoid being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by his own men, Sah made peace with Gaan as they took cover from the clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]' [[Blaster/Legends|weapons]]. The Klatooinian ordered the settlers to [[Ground warfare/Legends|open fire]] on the clones, and the pariahs quickly won the short [[Battle of Ragmar V|skirmish]]. The settlement began to make preparations to fight a second wave of clone troopers who arrived a short [[Time/Legends|time]] later.

==Biography==
===Outer Rim outcast===
{{Quote|We'll only get one shot at this&mdash;Make it count.|Another outcast as he loads the Klatooinian's rocket launcher|<ref name="TOO" />}}
A [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] lived during the final [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point he joined a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|settlement]] of pariahs on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]]. He was still there<ref name="TOO" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="NEG1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref>&mdash;an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] conflict that had begun during the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEG2">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> It was during that final year of the war when [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic armies]] arrived on Ragmar V in hopes of building an outpost, which they planned to use as a staging ground for an upcoming attack on the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TOO" />

[[File:Ragmar_V_Standoff.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Klatooinian gives the order to fire on Sergeant Remy's men.]]
The Ragmar V settlement's leader, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Gaan]], detested the Republic's presence for his own reasons, and ordered the Klatooinian to fire a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] at a Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] that had landed on a nearby mesa. Although the Klatooinian's projectile destroyed the gunship, the occupants&mdash;a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Joc Sah]] and his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachment&mdash;survived. As Sah and his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] began to make their way to the settlement, the Klatooinian and [[Unidentified Klatooinian outcast 2|another member of his species]] rounded up a number of the settlers in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], where Gaan began to lay out a [[Ground warfare/Legends|plan of attack]] to repel the Republic forces.<ref name="TOO" />

Gaan ordered everybody to the rooftops while he would confront the Republic forces in the streets. The Human made a special note that he wanted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Jedi himself.<ref name="TOO" />

===Rooftop ambush===
{{Quote|Wha&mdash;?! Hold your fire!''"<br />"''It's not us&mdash;the clones are firing at the Jedi!|Gaan calls for his men to hold their fire, and the Klatooinian corrects him|<ref name="TOO" />}}
[[File:JocGaan-OrderofOutcasts.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Klatooinian was present when Joc Sah spoke with Gaan.]]
As the settlers made their ways to the rooftops, the Klatooinian took a [[Unidentified Rodian outcast|Rodian]], a [[Unidentified Bith outcast|Bith]], and a [[Unidentified red-headed Human female outcast|Human female]] to the roof of a building that directly overlooked Gaan's position in the street, and from there they waited for Gaan's signal to [[Laser/Legends|fire]]. Gaan met the Republic forces in the street and briefly exchanged words with Sah. However, Sah's [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]], [[Remy (clone trooper)|Remy]], received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] just then from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]; Order 66 labeled all Jedi as traitors of the Republic, and they were to be executed on sight without hesitation. Remy followed the command and ordered his men to [[Battle of Ragmar V|open fire]] on Sah, forcing the Jedi to take cover inside a building.<ref name="TOO" />

Gaan, however, thought that his men had opened fire from the rooftops without the signal, but the Klatooinian, still on a roof himself, was quick to point out that the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire had originated from the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. Gaan, who still wanted to kill the Jedi, angrily killed a clone trooper, which caused the rest of the troopers to attack him. As Gaan took cover with Sah, the Klatooinian gave his own order to fire in retaliation for the attack on Gaan. The fight was brief, and Gaan killed Remy during the skirmish. Sah, realizing he was now alone, agreed to band with the outcasts and face another detachment of clone troopers that would be arriving to ensure Sah's elimination. The Klatooinian and the others [[Lightfight|battled]] the clones upon their arrival.<ref name="TOO" />

At some point, Gaan and Sah both escaped into the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of Ragmar V, and from there, they performed a number of hit-and-run attacks against the clone troopers.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|123|Sah, Joc}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Do we look like the type to run away from a fight?|Gaan, describing the Klatooinian and the other outcasts|<ref name="TOO" />}}
The Klatooinian was not sympathetic to the Republic, and followed Gaan's order to destroy a Republic gunship on sight. He worked closely with Gaan and held some leadership roles, relaying orders from Gaan and giving his own orders when the Human was unavailable.<ref name="TOO" />

While Klatooinians generally had five-fingered [[Limb/Legends|hands]] like most Humans and Human [[Species/Legends|subspecies]],<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> this one and his Klatooinian partner both had hands with two fingers and a thumb. The Klatooinian had brown-[[Color/Legends|colored]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOO" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Klatoo_Outcast_One_2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Klatooinian about to fire his missile launcher]]
The Klatooinian was known to make use of several weapons during the confrontation with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Remy's men. These weapons included a large [[Missile/Legends|missile]] launcher that he used&mdash;with his final missile&mdash;to destroy a Republic gunship, and a large [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] with a [[Scope/Legends|scope]]. The Klatooinian also made use of two [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistols]] that he wielded simultaneously against Remy and his men.<ref name="TOO" />

The Klatooinian wore a [[Belt/Legends|belt]] full of pouches and a [[Bandolier/Legends|bandolier]], along with shoulder pads.<ref name="TOO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Klatooinian was created for the short story "[[The Order of Outcasts]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5|fifth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperback]] series. The story was written by [[Matt Jacobs]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="TOO" /> on [[April 12]], [[2006]].<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/13-402/Star-Wars-Clone-Wars-Adventures-Vol-5-TPB|text=Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Vol. 5 TPB}}</ref>
